final: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(analysis_count) AS average_count, SUM(analysis_count) AS total_count FROM counts) SELECT SUM(c.analysis_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(c.analysis_count * 1.0 / totals.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.analysis_count - totals.average_count) AS average_excess FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE c.analysis_count > totals.average_count
